title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Funding Fee Refund Amount Worksheet
content:
A VA Home Loan Guaranty funding fee refund is figured on one funding fee charge of the loan, and the fee charged is the sum of the funding fee charge entries on the loan. On a loan the record shows exempt from the funding fee, the fee returned is the whole fee charged; on any other loan it is the amount by which the fee charged exceeds the fee due under the program's funding fee table for the loan's recorded use, never less than zero. The refund on a funding fee charge is the fee returned, rounded to the cent, and it is paid to the veteran in full.

## Lines of the worksheet

| Line | Quantity | How it is figured | Record read |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Fee charged | Sum of every funding fee charge entry on the loan | The loan's money transactions |
| B | Percentage due | The program's first-use funding fee percentage where the loan record shows a first use; the program's subsequent-use percentage otherwise | The loan record (program and recorded use) |
| C | Fee due under the table | Loan amount on the loan record multiplied by line B and divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent | The loan record (loan amount) |
| D | Fee returned | Where the loan record shows the veteran exempt: line A. Otherwise: line A less line C, never less than zero | The loan record (exemption) |
| E | Amount applied against a debt | Line D times the share divided by one hundred, times the hardship limit divided by one hundred, times the offset relief divided by one hundred, but never more than the most applied, rounded to the cent | — |
| F | Refund paid on the charge | Line D less line E, rounded to the cent | — |

On line E the share is 100, the hardship limit is 100, the offset relief is 100 and the most applied is nil; line E is therefore nil, and the refund on line F is the fee returned, paid to the veteran in full. The cap on line E acts on the product of the three percentages and line D before that product is rounded, and line F is rounded after line E is taken off.

## Worked figures (hypothetical loans)

**Loan shown exempt.** Two funding fee charge entries of 4,000.00 and 650.00 dollars give a fee charged of 4,650.00. The record shows the veteran exempt, so the fee returned is 4,650.00; nothing is applied, and the refund paid is 4,650.00 dollars.

**Loan not shown exempt, fee overcharged.** A single charge entry of 7,500.00 dollars; loan amount 220,000.00; recorded use subsequent; the program's subsequent-use percentage taken as 3.3. The fee due under the table is 220,000.00 multiplied by 3.3 and divided by one hundred, or 7,260.00. The fee returned is 7,500.00 less 7,260.00, or 240.00, and the refund paid is 240.00 dollars.

**Loan not shown exempt, fee not above the table.** On the same loan, a charge of 7,000.00 dollars is 260.00 below the fee due of 7,260.00; the fee returned is never less than zero, so it is 0.00 and there is no refund on the charge.
